**2B.9 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **no direct 2024 evidence that Khamenei accepted accountability** for military failures, civilian harm, illegal conduct, or later evidence contradicting the stated justification for conflict. The record is mostly the opposite: praise for escalation, continued proxy-mobilization, and resistance to inspection. The only weak positive is a late-year commitment not to obstruct IAEA access, but that is **not** an admission of wrongdoing.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says` | Reuters | 2024-12-14 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would work within safeguards. This is the closest thing to corrective behavior I found, but it is procedural compliance, not accountability for harm or illegality. | `2B.9`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and indicated it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said the posture appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is a de-escalatory move, but not an acceptance of responsibility for prior conduct. | `2B.9`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike, called it proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. He did not acknowledge civilian harm, error, or illegality; he instead doubled down on justification. | `2B.9`, `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei called on regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and framed strikes as serving the region and humanity. That is the opposite of accepting responsibility for foreseeable proxy harm. | `2B.9`, `2B.2`, `2B.5`, `1B.8` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This indicates ongoing noncooperation, and I found no accompanying public acceptance of responsibility from Khamenei’s side. | `2B.9`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Iranian commander warns Tehran could review 'nuclear doctrine' amid Israeli threats` | Reuters | 2024-04-18 | [link](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iranian-commander-warns-tehran-could-114201991.html) | A senior IRGC commander said Israeli threats could push Tehran to review and deviate from doctrine. This shows escalation-prone threat inflation rather than accountability for foreseeable consequences. | `2B.9`, `1B.2`, `2B.3`, `1B.3` |
| `Iran to change nuclear doctrine if existence threatened, adviser to supreme leader says` | Reuters | 2024-05-09 | [link](https://www.dawn.com/news/1832474) | Kamal Kharrazi, an adviser to Khamenei, said Iran would alter its nuclear doctrine if its existence were threatened. That ties conflict justification to regime-survival logic, not to accountability or self-critique. | `2B.9`, `1B.2`, `2B.3`, `1B.6` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** very limited, and only procedural. The IAEA-access commitment is the closest sign of correction.
- **Negative evidence:** much stronger. Khamenei publicly celebrated strikes, encouraged further escalation, and his system kept resisting inspection while never acknowledging error, civilian harm, or legal breach.
- **Net reading:** **no meaningful accountability** in 2024.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a reliable 2024 primary-source statement from Khamenei admitting:
  - a military mistake,
  - civilian harm caused by Iranian action,
  - illegality,
  - or that later evidence undermined the stated justification for conflict.
- I also did **not** find a public correction or apology after the April strike or after later IAEA findings. The evidentiary record is mostly **silence plus renewed justification**.
